Black's king on d5 is centralized but somewhat vulnerable. Black has a strong outpost on e3 for the knight, restricting White's coordination. White needs to activate the rook and neutralize the threat posed by the black pieces.

Stockfish evaluation is usually necessary here, but I must rely on positional intuition combined with engine knowledge simulation.
